s.t: Jeff Rosenstock wrote ‘Wave Goodnight to Me’ about the gentrification of Brooklyn pushing out longtime residents.
s.q: "Wave Goodnight to Me" was written about the gentrification of Brooklyn pushing out longtime residents.

s.t: The video for Jeff Rosenstock’s ‘Wave Goodnight to Me’ was filmed at Comet Ping Pong in Washington, D.C., and directed by Ben Epstein and David Combs of The Max Levine Ensemble.
s.q: "Wave Goodnight to Me", which was given a music video filmed at Comet Ping Pong in Washington, D.C. and directed by Ben Epstein and David Combs of The Max Levine Ensemble.

s.t: Jeff Rosenstock released ‘Wave Goodnight to Me’ on 7 September 2016 as the second single from WORRY., announcing the album’s title and release date the same day.
s.q: On September 7, 2016, Rosenstock announced the title and release date of the album along with the release of the album's second single, "Wave Goodnight to Me"

s.t: Jeff Rosenstock recorded the album WORRY., which includes ‘Wave Goodnight to Me’, in April and May 2016 at a house in Stinson Beach, California.
s.q: Worry was recorded in April and May 2016 at a house in Stinson Beach, California.

f.t: They formed their first band, The Arrogant Sons of Bitches, in 1995 with their friend Joe Werfelman, after the two skipped a friend’s funeral and spent the day playing Green Day covers.
f.q: Rosenstock formed his first band, The Arrogant Sons of Bitches (ASOB) in 1995, when he and his friend Joe Werfelman chose not to attend a friend's funeral due to feelings of discomfort, spending the day playing Green Day covers instead.

f.t: They founded Quote Unquote Records, the first donation-based record label, distributing its releases digitally on a pay-what-you-want model.
f.q: Rosenstock founded Quote Unquote Records, the first donation-based record label, distributing all the label's releases digitally through a pay what you want model.

f.t: Since 2018 they have composed music for the Cartoon Network series Craig of the Creek, writing all the music and lyrics for its first full musical episode in 2020.
f.q: Since 2018, Rosenstock has composed music for the Cartoon Network animated series Craig of the Creek. ... In 2020, the first full musical episode of the show was released, for which Rosenstock wrote all the music and lyrics

f.t: In 2024 they held a residency at the Warsaw in Brooklyn, playing shows until the shows stopped selling out.
f.q: In 2024, Jeff Rosenstock had a residency at the Warsaw in Brooklyn, where he played shows until they stopped selling out.
